Class PerformanceSectionInfo

java.lang.Object
org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.internal.PerformanceSectionInfo
@ClassVersion(sourceVersion="$Id: PerformanceSectionInfo.java 1216 2026-05-02 11:16:24Z tquadrat $") @API(status=INTERNAL, since="0.25.0") public class PerformanceSectionInfo extends Object

Instances of this class holds the execution status for a "Performance Section".

    • m_CumulatedExecutionTime

      private long m_CumulatedExecutionTime
      The accumulated execution time of the performance section since the last restart of the program, in milliseconds.

    • m_FirstStart

      private Instant m_FirstStart

      The time when the performance section was first started after the last restart of the program.

    • m_LastUpdated

      private Instant m_LastUpdated

      The time when this performance section info was last updated. This attribute is used to determine when the report entries for the performance section should be discarded.

    • m_NumberOfAbortedRuns

      private int m_NumberOfAbortedRuns

      The number of aborted runs that timed out since the last restart of the program. These are not included in m_NumberOfCompletedRuns.

      See Also:
      • m_FirstStart

    • m_NumberOfCompletedRuns

      private int m_NumberOfCompletedRuns
      The number of runs with an elapsed time since the last restart of the program.
      See Also:
      • m_FirstStart

    • m_NumberOfRunsThatExceededThreshold

      private int m_NumberOfRunsThatExceededThreshold

      The number of runs that exceeded the threshold since the last restart of the program. These are included in m_NumberOfCompletedRuns.

      See Also:
      • m_FirstStart

    • m_NumberOfTimedOutRuns

      private int m_NumberOfTimedOutRuns

      The number of runs that timed out since the last restart of the program. These are not included in m_NumberOfCompletedRuns nor in m_NumberOfAbortedRuns.

      See Also:
      • m_FirstStart

  • Constructor Details

    • PerformanceSectionInfo

      public PerformanceSectionInfo(PerformanceSection performanceSection)
      Creates a new instance of PerformanceSectionInfo.
      Parameters:
      performanceSection - The performance section.

    • PerformanceSectionInfo

      public PerformanceSectionInfo(PerformanceSectionName performanceSectionName)

      Creates a new instance of PerformanceSectionInfo.

      The wrapped PerformanceSection instance will be created on the fly with default values:

      • Description: empty
      • Threshold: disabled
      • Timeout: disabled
      • Sending Report for Abort: true
      • Active: true
      Parameters:
      performanceSectionName - The name for a new performance section with default settings.

    • PerformanceSectionInfo

      public PerformanceSectionInfo(String performanceSectionName)

      Creates a new instance of PerformanceSectionInfo.

      The wrapped PerformanceSection instance will be created on the fly with default values:

      • Description: empty
      • Threshold: disabled
      • Timeout: disabled
      • Sending Report for Abort: true
      • Active: true
      Parameters:
      performanceSectionName - The name for a new performance section with default settings.

    • getNumberOfAbortedRuns

      public final OptionalInt getNumberOfAbortedRuns()

      Returns the number of aborted runs. Will be empty if no run was recorded yet.

      Runs that timed out are not included in this number.

      Returns:
      An instance of OptionalInt that holds the number of aborted runs.

    • getNumberOfCompletedRuns

      public final OptionalInt getNumberOfCompletedRuns()

      Returns the number of completed runs. These are the runs that provided an elapsed time. Will be empty if no run was recorded yet.

      Returns:
      An instance of OptionalInt that holds the number of completed runs.

    • getNumberOfRunsThatExceededThreshold

      public final OptionalInt getNumberOfRunsThatExceededThreshold()

      Returns the number of completed runs that exceeded the threshold. These runs are also included into the number of completed runs. Will be empty if no run was recorded yet.

      Returns:
      An instance of OptionalInt that holds the number of completed runs exceeding the threshold.

    • getNumberOfTimedOutRuns

      public final OptionalInt getNumberOfTimedOutRuns()

      Returns the number of runs that timed ot. Will be empty if no run was recorded yet.

      Runs that were aborted due to other reasons than a timeout are not included in this number.

      Returns:
      An instance of OptionalInt that holds the number of timed out runs.

    • isIgnored

      public final boolean isIgnored()

    • isAverageAboveThreshold

      public final boolean isAverageAboveThreshold()

      Checks whether the average execution time is above the threshold for the performance section. If the threshold is disabled, the method returns false.

      Returns:
      true if the average execution time is above the threshold, false otherwise.
      See Also:
      • PerformanceSection.getThreshold()

    • isSendingReportOnlyForExceededThreshold

      public final boolean isSendingReportOnlyForExceededThreshold()
      Returns the flag that indicates whether reports should be sent only if the threshold was exceeded.
      Returns:
      true if a report should be sent only when the threshold was exceeded, false if a report should be sent always.
